text:
[Council File 26-1617; CD 11]
City Administrative Officer and Housing Department reports relative to adopting the Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act of 1982 Resolution and Minutes, issuing tax-exempt and taxable multifamily conduit revenue bonds, and related actions for the Adda and Paul Safran Senior Housing Apartments Project, a supportive housing project.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
